# Apple

> Apple's official website showcasing its comprehensive ecosystem of hardware products, services, and innovations including iPhones, Macs, iPads, wearables, and spatial computing devices.

Apple.com serves as the primary destination for product information, purchasing, and service discovery across Apple's entire hardware and software portfolio. The site features detailed product pages, accessories, entertainment services, and brand heritage content.

## Key Topics

- iPhone
- Mac
- iPad
- Apple Watch
- AirPods
- Apple Intelligence
- Apple Vision Pro
- Apple Services
- Spatial Audio
- M-series Chips
- HomeKit
- Apple TV+
- Apple Music
- Apple Card
- Apple Trade In

## iPhone & Mobile

- [iPhone - Apple](https://www.apple.com/iphone): iPhone product overview with models 17, Air, and Pro variants

## Mac & Computing

- [Mac - Apple](https://www.apple.com/mac): Mac product lineup featuring MacBook Neo, Air, Pro, and desktops
- [MacBook Pro - Apple](https://www.apple.com/macbook-pro): MacBook Pro with M5, M5 Pro, and M5 Max chips for professionals
- [MacBook Neo - Apple](https://www.apple.com/macbook-neo): MacBook Neo laptop with Apple Intelligence and Liquid Retina

## iPad & Tablets

- [iPad - Apple](https://www.apple.com/ipad): iPad product family including Pro, Air, mini, and standard models
- [iPad Air - Apple](https://www.apple.com/ipad-air): iPad Air tablet with M4 chip and Apple Intelligence features

## Wearables & Audio

- [Apple Watch - Apple](https://www.apple.com/watch): Apple Watch lineup: Series 11, SE 3, and Ultra 3 smartwatches
- [Apple Watch Series 11 - Apple](https://www.apple.com/apple-watch-series-11): Apple Watch Series 11 smartwatch with health monitoring features
- [AirPods - Apple](https://www.apple.com/airpods): AirPods audio product lineup: Pro 3, Max 2, and AirPods 4
- [AirPods Max 2 - Apple](https://www.apple.com/airpods-max): AirPods Max 2 over-ear headphones with spatial audio technology

## Spatial Computing & Smart Home

- [Apple Vision Pro - Apple](https://www.apple.com/apple-vision-pro): Apple Vision Pro spatial computing headset with M5 chip
- [TV & Home - Apple](https://www.apple.com/tv-home): Smart home products: HomePod, Apple TV 4K, and HomeKit

## Services & Entertainment

- [Entertainment - Services - Apple](https://www.apple.com/entertainment): Apple services: TV+, Music, Arcade, Fitness+, and One bundle

## Shopping & Accessories

- [Apple Accessories for Apple Watch, iPhone, iPad, Mac and Vision Pro - Apple](https://www.apple.com/us/shop/goto/buy_accessories): Apple accessories shop for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Watch, Vision Pro
